examples.en: If you look at the paper under a microscope you will see the fibres.
examples.zh: 如果你在显微镜下观察这张纸，你就会看到纤维。

examples.en: The sperm sample is checked under the microscope before insemination is carried out.
examples.zh: 进行受精前用显微镜检查精子样本。

examples.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
examples.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。
